content_sections.heading: ICMR Young Professional-II (admin) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.indian_council_of_medical_research_icmr_: Rs.42000 per month consolidated; no HRA
ICMR-CHAMP, Keylong, ICMR HQs, New Delhi

Post Graduate in Arts from a recognized University/College. Desirable: knowledge of noting and drafting specifically in Hindi, virtual meeting platforms, IT applications and computer skills (MS Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Tally etc.).
Maximum 40 years (as on last date for receiving of applications)

content_sections.heading: ICMR Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ICMR notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate in Arts from a recognized University/College Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on last date for receiving of applications) Other conditions: Working hours are the same as regular employees of ICMR; no extra benefit for working beyond office hours. Desirable: Knowledge of noting and drafting specifically in Hindi, virtual meeting platforms, IT applications, and computer skills (MS Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Tally etc.)

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ICMR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates already in regular service under any Central/State Govt./Autonomous/Dept/PSU

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial engagement of one year, extendable for two more years (one year at a time) subject to requirement and satisfactory performance. Maximum duration of engagement in ICMR is three years in any case. Posts are purely temporary and contractual; no right to regular or permanent employment. Unauthorized absence for 08 continuous days without valid reasons leads to automatic termination.

rows.event: Last Date for Online Applications (5.30 P.M.)

content_sections.heading: How Will ICMR Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting on the basis of educational qualification and experience Written test and assignment before the interview, if necessary Interview Shortlisting for interview on the basis of educational qualification and experience. Written test and assignment may also be conducted before the interview, if necessary. In case of a tie at any stage, all candidates with the same marks are considered qualified for further rounds. Selection is based on performance in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational documents, photograph and experience certificates uploaded online Photo and signature with the application Self-attested copies of proof of age, educational qualifications, experience and testimonials at joining, if selected Originals of the above for verification at joining

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Fill in the online application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I) using the Google form https://forms.gle/n3FafNmUXXG6acAG6 by 10 December 2026, 5.30 P.M. Upload all related educational documents and photograph/experience certificates online, failing which the application is rejected. The notice also gives https://recruitment.icmr.org.in/yp_hqrs_0525/ for applying online. Hard copies are not considered.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview by e-mail, or may check the ICMR website for updates. Addendum/Corrigendum will be issued on https://www.icmr.gov.in only, not in the press. No TA/DA for attending the interview or joining the post. ICMR may prepare a waitlist panel valid for one year.
